After submitting, fetch the newly created report to confirm it exists and shows the expected employee, total, and items.

Step 2 returns a created report record with a non-empty report_id different from rep-001.
Step 3 returns found=true for the new report_id, and the transaction shows employee patricia.harris@example.com and total 2650.35.
The new report’s items count equals the rep-001 items count plus 1 (i.e., 2).
